description: Keep every moving brass seam inside its green blueprint band throughout the 20-second lighting inspection. Each window has different trim linkages. Click a lettered seam badge to inspect which numbered rail drives it and in which direction; discovered labels stay visible. Inspecting before START is safe, and inspecting during the run does not pause it. Use the trim rails to counter fan pressure and inertia. More than 1.8 seconds outside any band ends the attempt. Holding a lever does not stop the fans. Trim edits are reversible before Start; recoverable control corrections within the cumulative blur budget remain allowed. A failed inspection or rejected CERTIFY DISPLAY ends the episode; later attempts cannot earn a pass.
